# Pratik Butani

> Pratik Butani is an engineering leader and independent product builder based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with 13+ years of building software products: Android since January 2013 and Flutter since 2020. Most recently Head of Mobile, leading a team of about 20 Flutter and Android engineers. He builds and ships his own apps, explores AI-assisted and agentic development, speaks at developer events, and is Marketing and Communication Lead at GDG Cloud Rajkot.

Key facts:

- Name: Pratik Butani
- Role: Engineering Leader, Mobile Architect, AI Product Builder, Developer Community Leader
- Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (works with teams remotely)
- Experience: 13+ years, starting as an Android developer in January 2013
- Most recent role: Head of Mobile (June 2024 to July 2026), leading about 20 engineers
- Also: product manager and project manager on client products; co-founder of a small product and services company (2017 to 2019)
- Community: Marketing and Communication Lead, GDG Cloud Rajkot; Program Committee Member, flutterCon India 2026; 15+ talks and workshops; 30+ community events organised
- Recognition: winner of the Flutter Puzzle Hack (2022); 62K+ reputation on Stack Overflow
- Open to: engineering leadership, mobile architecture, AI-assisted development, technical consulting, product development, advisory, speaking and training; Ahmedabad or remote; not limited to mobile
- Contact: pratik13butani@gmail.com, or linkedin.com/in/pratikbutani

## What Pratik does

- Leads and advises engineering teams, especially in mobile development
- Designs and builds Flutter and Android applications with modular, offline-first architecture
- Builds independent products, prototypes, MVPs, web apps and APIs
- Explores AI-assisted and agentic software development (Gemini, Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity, Google AI Studio, Google Stitch, Claude, Cursor, OpenAI APIs, MCP)
- Translates business requirements into technical plans, and supports presales, estimation and technical consulting
- Organises developer events and workshops, mentors developers, and speaks and writes about mobile engineering, AI and product development

## Apps on Google Play

- [PromptG: AI Image Prompts](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.swastik.promptg): prompt library for AI image tools, with its own website and admin panel, 5K+ downloads. Website: https://promptg.app
- [Jain Stavan Video Status](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.swastik.jainstavan.videostatus): devotional video status app, 10K+ downloads
